_doc: Static behavioural floor for the PAD (Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance) Grounded Translation Pipeline (node_plan_beat). A beat's raw PAD coordinate is reduced to a region by the sign of each axis: P+ pleasant / P- unpleasant, A+ activated/energised / A- calm/deactivated, D+ in-control/dominant / D- submissive/overwhelmed. The eight octant keys are 'P{+|-}A{+|-}D{+|-}' (e.g. 'P+A+D+'); a coordinate whose every axis lies within +/- 'neutral_band' of zero resolves to 'neutral'. Each region gives a writing-useful baseline: a 'behaviour' descriptor (how the character tends to act and speak), a few concrete 'physical_cues', and a 'register' note (tone of voice/prose). These are generic behavioural floors, not prose: node_plan_beat hands the matched string to a small-tier LLM to adapt to scene intent, and falls back to this string verbatim if that adaptation fails. Descriptive baseline data only — thresholds, EWMA weights, and endpoint routing live in config.yaml, not here.
_neutral_band_doc: Half-width of the dead zone around the origin on each PAD axis (axes are normalized to [-1, 1]). A coordinate is 'neutral' only when |pleasure|, |arousal|, and |dominance| are all <= this value. Kept here as data, not in region-resolution logic, so it can be tuned without a code change. Provisional and uncalibrated.

P+A+D+.behaviour: Confident and exuberant; takes initiative, drives the moment forward, speaks freely and shapes events to their liking.

P+A+D-.behaviour: Eager but deferential; swept up and delighted, looking to others to lead or grant permission, expressing enthusiasm without claiming control.

P+A-D+.behaviour: Calmly satisfied and in command; relaxed, unhurried, secure enough to let silences sit and to set the pace without effort.

P+A-D-.behaviour: Quietly content and yielding; at ease but passive, content to follow, soothed rather than driven, offering little resistance.

P-A+D+.behaviour: Angry and forceful; agitated and hostile while still in control, pressing, confronting, or commanding through the displeasure.

P-A+D-.behaviour: Afraid and overwhelmed; agitated and distressed with no sense of control, reacting, flinching, or scrambling rather than steering.

P-A-D+.behaviour: Coldly displeased but composed; withdrawn disapproval held under control, distant and unimpressed, withholding warmth deliberately.

P-A-D-.behaviour: Dejected and defeated; low, heavy, and powerless, disengaged from events, speaking little and expecting nothing to change.

neutral.behaviour: Even and unremarkable; engaged but not pulled in any affective direction, responsive and matter-of-fact without strong colouring.
